The Pet Rescue Center is a 501c3 non profit charity based in Orange County, CA.  Our mission is to work with the communities of California, shelters, veterinarians and animal rescue groups to save the lives of dogs and cats at risk of euthanasia due to overpopulation through education, spay/neuter and rescue programs. In this effort, we provide a no-kill, veterinary supervised temporary sanctuary for these pets while we work to locate an adopting family.

Our YouTube Channel will host videos of our programs funded by community contributions in action - these include Rescue.Rehab.Rehome., Community Outreach, Children's Education, & Medical Needs.
